findings.title: Rotation detail window on a phone: the sector chip row scrolls sideways with no cue
findings.where: Rotation tab, Rotation detail (rotB) window, 390 and 360, dark and light
findings.steps: Real data, phone width, Rotation tab, expand Rotation detail; look at the chip row (Industrials, Energy, Tech, Cons. Cyc, Basic Ma...)
findings.expected: Same cue as other sideways scrollers (the xs-r edge fade, MX-2 fix)
findings.actual: .c1-chips scrollWidth 890 > clientWidth 388, className has no xs-r/xs-l, the last visible chip 'Basic Ma' is cut hard at the window edge; 6 more chips are off screen with no hint
findings.evidence: p1.json (rotB scr 'c1-chips 890>388'), z_rotB_390.png; check1.mjs cue test only walks [data-card] descendants so it does not see it

findings.title: Rotation detail window on a phone: 'Changes / All columns' switch wraps into two stacked rows inside the 52 px band and the subtitle is cut
findings.steps: Phone, expand Rotation detail, look at the 'Quadrant changes' band
findings.expected: One row switch, title and subtitle whole (user: C1 one 52 px band, nothing cut)
findings.actual: The seg is 147x52 (390) / 134x52 (360) with 'Changes' above 'All columns' (buttons at y 197 and 221), border touching the band lines; subtitle '28 changes in 52 weeks . Industrials' cut to 'Industr...' (scrollWidth 207 > 199 at 390, > 182 at 360)

findings.title: Keyboard focus is invisible on the Rotation map's sector dots and the Relative strength Rank change rows
findings.where: Rotation tab rotA (g.pt) and Relative strength tab rsB (g.sl), any width, dark and light
findings.steps: Tab to a sector dot of the Rotation map (or a row of the Rank change slope chart); compare screenshots before and after focus
findings.expected: Grey focus ring (decision 12) on every focusable control
findings.actual: Both are tabindex=0 and :focus-visible matches but nothing is drawn: computed outline none; pixel-identical screenshots with and without focus. sector.css:271 `.rrg .pt{outline:none}` and :230 `.slope .sl{outline:none}` come after and win over the :113 `.pt:focus-visible`/`.sl:focus-visible` rule at the same specificity. circle.dt, ovx-dot, cards do show the ring
findings.evidence: p10.cjs (noRing g.sl, g.pt), p12.cjs (pixels differ: false for rotA g.pt, rsB g.sl; true for circle.dt), kb_gpt.png
